values.formattedValue: 1. Go to the 'Packaging' tab. Each print size we sell on Shopify already has a row.

values.formattedValue: Packages needed = quantity ÷ max prints per package, rounded up. Total weight = (packages × empty package weight) + (quantity × weight of 1 print). Uses the first row on the Packaging tab that matches the size. Shows blank until that size's yellow cells are filled in.
